attributes.title: 2027 AAD Annual Meeting
attributes.summary:
The 2027 AAD Annual Meeting takes place March 19 to 23, 2027, in San Francisco, California. Alongside the scientific sessions it includes an exhibit hall, affiliate group meetings and a practice-management day called The Business of Dermatology.

Registration is open. Early-bird fees apply until noon Central time on February 17, 2027: $1,135 for physician members, $2,635 for non-member physicians and $340 for residents and fellows. Standard fees after that are $1,365, $3,170 and $445. The meeting is in person only, with no virtual attendance option. The academy states the meeting is approved for AMA PRA Category 1 Credit, but the total was not listed on the pages we checked; the venue has not been named there either.
